author: EDJM9
body:
Application For EDJM9


Age: 14

Timezone: Eastern US

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?

Yes, I was referee on Avicus for a short time, and I have just applied for Ref again. I reffed during T3: Battle Of Eternity. I am currently moderator on alexanderjoe's build server.


What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

My biggest weakness probably is the fact that I do not know many of the hacks and clients out there, but I am taking steps to improve my knowledge. I have been watching videos on what to look for in a suspicious hacker, and the different kinds of hacks and clients. My biggest strength is that I won't abuse my permissions, and I can listen to both sides and make a decision. I can also be online moderating for 9-10 hours a week.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

I think that Avicus does not advertise enough. If I become a Moderator, I will push the staff team to advertise more. I will increase Avicus’s player count, and by advertising Avicus I think we can. People think Avicus is dying, but I think it is an opportunity. I also feel that I am vital to the staff team as I can moderate online, and I won't be inactive.


What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

Leaders should have many good qualities, but they should definitely these 4 attributes: communication, commitment, collaboration, and creativity. Communication: a leader of Avicus must be able to communicate with the community to give updates to them on current projects and other events. A leader should arrange times to meet with the community and discuss questions they have. Commitment: A person who is not committed to their cause are not giving their all. You must be committed to something in order for you to do your best at it. Collaboration: A leader must work well with groups of people. They need to be able to talk to the community and work with them to improve the server and improve game play. Creativity: A leader must be creative so they can grab the attention of the community and find creative ways to bring the community together. I believe that I have all of these qualities and more. At a time I was the leader of a competitive team, I needed to have these traits so the team did not die out. And it did not with my leadership skills.


What attributes distinguish you from others?

I think I have many good qualities, but some distinguish me from others and make me the right choice for moderator. Patience: A good moderator must have patience to record the hacker and get solid evidence. They also must be able to listen to both sides of an argument and make a decision. I am also not biased, and I can be neutral when it comes to a tough decision. I also know most of the commands and rules of being a moderator. I am loyal, kind, and if chosen to be moderator, I will uphold the good name of the network.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

When interacting with the community, you should get your point across while taking in their opinion. You need to listen to the community and take in what they are saying, process it, and take action, while taking into account their opinion matters.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?

As I said before, around 9-10 hours a week.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

I would ping staff on slack or dischord, and continue to /freeze the hackers, but if I had no evidence I would not punish.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

I would record the staff member, and show the recording to a senior mod or admin. The senior staff team / official team would have to carry out the actions after that.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

I couldn’t really do anything. If there isn’t any evidence, there is no ban.


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

I would tell a senior mod about this incident, hopefully my friend would get let off with a warning.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

Before making my verdict, I would see how much information I can gather and then make a decision.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

I would be honestly thrilled. It has been a goal of mine for a long time. I enjoy playing on here, and being moderator makes me feel like I can make a difference on here.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

As I said before, I joined Avicus 2 years ago. I think this server has great potential, we just need to work it out and perfect the system. I've had so many memories on this server that I don't think I would have anywhere else. This server means a lot to me, as I spent a lot of time on here.


Do you speak any other languages than English?

I speak a little spanish, and I speak Gujarati (kinda useless on here, its a variation of Hindi).


Do you have anything else to add to your application?

I think the Senior Team should give me a chance. No one is perfect, and I think I possess excellent qualities for moderating. I think I have improved in maturity since my last time applying. I won't let the Senior Team down if I am accepted. Thanks for reading my application, and I hope I get accepted! Thanks.


~EDJM9

You may not submit another application.
